OPERATIVE REPORT

Procedure Date: fictional index year (see accompanying test harness for the assigned
Service Date)

Preoperative Diagnosis: Severe native aortic stenosis.
Procedure: Aortic valve replacement with bioprosthesis via median sternotomy.

The patient underwent an uncomplicated median sternotomy and was placed on cardiopulmonary
bypass. The heavily calcified native trileaflet valve was excised. A Magna Ease valve was
selected after annular sizing.

Tissue Implant Type: Bioprosthesis
Valve Type Used: Magna Ease
Implant Size: 21

Separation from bypass was uneventful. Intraoperative echocardiography demonstrated the
mean gradient is 10 mmHg with no significant paravalvular leak. The patient was transferred
to the intensive care unit in stable condition.
